&reftitle.description;
voidstream_bucket_append resourcebrigade StreamBucketbucket
Appends bucket to the end of brigade. It is typically called from php_user_filter::filter to pass data on to the next filter.
The current value of the data property of bucket is copied into the bucket first. A bucket that is already part of a brigade is moved, not duplicated.

&reftitle.parameters;
brigade
The bucket brigade to append to, one of the two brigades passed to php_user_filter::filter.
bucket
The bucket to append, as returned by stream_bucket_make_writeable or stream_bucket_new.
